svg.aria-label: Nexscope API usage trend, seven-day rolling median
svg.title: Nexscope API usage trend
svg.desc: Seven-day rolling median of valid daily API requests, September 6 to 29, 2026. The typical level rose through mid-September and eased toward month-end. Individual daily spikes are smoothed.
